title: Statement Balance Add-On to the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Late Fee
content:
A Ridgeline Consumer Credit late fee carries a balance add-on set by the latest statement balance — the balance on the most recent statement issued:

| Latest statement balance | Balance add-on |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 4.00 |
| 1000.00 or more but less than 5000.00 | 2.00 |
| less than 1000.00 | nothing |

**How it is applied.** The balance add-on is added to the fee level, the amount the late fee starts from; the sum is the late fee as it then stands.

## Questions answered

**A statement balance of 999.99?** No add-on. **Of exactly 1000.00?** 2.00. **Of 4999.99?** 2.00. **Of exactly 5000.00?** 4.00.

**Which statement counts when several are on file?** Only the latest statement issued.

**Hypothetical:** a fee level of 43.00 and a latest statement balance of 2350.00 give 45.00.
